issues.problem: The error message 'No exam form available for submission.' is displayed in red, which might be difficult to read for users with low vision. Additionally, it's purely stylistic and doesn't contribute to accessibility.
issues.original_code:
class="box box-2 text-center p-6"
No exam form available for submission.
issues.fixed_code:
class="box box-2 text-center p-6"
No exam form available for submission.
issues.explanation: The color is changed from red to a default text color to improve readability for users with color blindness and visual impairments.  The fix does not change the meaning of the message.
issues.fix_diff:
--- original +++ fixed @@ -58 +58 @@ - class="box box-2 text-center p-6" -
- No exam form available for submission. -
+ class="box box-2 text-center p-6" +
No exam form available for submission.

issues.problem: The checkbox input is missing a label. This is a significant accessibility violation as screen readers will not be able to determine the purpose or function of the checkbox without a properly associated label.  This makes the component unusable for users with visual impairments.
issues.original_code:
<!-- <input
  type="checkbox"
  v-model="selectedSubjects"
  :value="{
    programTermUId: subject.programTermUId,
    termCourseAMATUId: subject.termCourseAMATUId,
    termCourseGroupUId: subject.termCourseGroupUId
  }"
  class="w-5 h-5 accent-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
  :disabled="!(userObj.studentLoginCrMode === 1 && selectedProgram?.appearanceType === 2)"
/> -->
issues.fixed_code:

  label="Select Subject"

issues.explanation: Added a `<label>` element that is associated with the checkbox input using the `for` attribute.  This makes the checkbox accessible to screen readers and users with visual impairments.
